column2: [intro]
In the morning I rise, everything’s a mess,
Socks in a jumble, still I laugh, I confess,
Car keys lost again, as usual,
But in this chaos, I always find my route, so crucial.
In my life, it’s organized chaos,
I’m disorganized, but it makes me toss,
Things pile up, it's a real clutter scene,
But I always find what I need, not too mean!
On my desk, papers are all around,
But I know exactly where every thought is found,
When I create, it’s a real disaster,
But it sparks my inspiration, like a master.
I’m a perfectionist in my own way,
Even if everything’s in disarray, I see the play,
My friends say I should tidy up now and then,
But I love seeing my life as a madman’s art, amen.
[ solo ]
So I’ll keep being messy, wild and free,
A crazy artist, never tamed, you see,
In this chaos, I find my liberty,
And it’s in the clutter where I’m truly happy!
[outro]
